userRequest: 这里多个值如何填写，要支持多个值判断啊
scope: explicit newline-separated multiple comparison values and examples
scalar IN and NOT_IN membership predicates; preserve single-value comparisons
consistent current branch and START authoring, parsing and validation
known empty and unknown remain distinct; comma remains literal text
